meta.name: email-render-builder
meta.description: Use when the user asks to "build the email HTML", "make this email responsive", "fix dark-mode rendering", or "QA the email across clients"; produces the coded HTML build — a responsive table layout, dark-mode + accessibility pass, a client-render matrix, image-block fallbacks, and a plain-text parity check. Not for writing the copy — use email-creative-builder; not for scoring the email or computing EQS — use email-quality-auditor. 邮件HTML/响应式邮件/暗色模式渲染

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 构建响应式邮件HTML，兼容各客户端与暗色模式
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要制作兼容多客户端的响应式邮件HTML
copy.tagline_en: Build responsive email HTML compatible across clients and dark mode
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create responsive email HTML that works across multiple clients

howto.what: 将邮件创意（文案、CTA、链接）转换为可直接使用的HTML代码。产出包括：响应式表格布局、暗色模式适配、无障碍检查结果、各邮件客户端渲染矩阵、图片关闭时的后备方案、纯文本版本一致性检查。
howto.when: 当你要求“生成邮件HTML”、“让邮件适配移动端”、“修复暗色模式渲染”或“跨客户端QA邮件”时触发。需要已确认的邮件创意或原始HTML。

say.text: 这个HTML在Outlook上渲染坏了，修复布局并添加图片关闭时的后备。
say.note: 修复后重新生成HTML并更新QA报告。

howto.what_en: Converts an approved email creative (copy, CTA, URL) into a production-ready HTML build. Output includes: responsive table layout, dark-mode pass, accessibility checklist, client-render matrix (Gmail/Outlook/Apple Mail/mobile), image-off fallbacks, bulletproof CTAs, and plain-text parity check.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to "build the email HTML", "make this email responsive", "fix dark-mode rendering", or "QA the email across clients". Requires an approved creative or raw HTML as input.

say_en.text: Build responsive HTML from this creative: subject ..., body ..., CTA URL ...
say_en.note: Produces full HTML and render-QA report.

say_en.text: QA this email HTML across Gmail, Outlook, and mobile. Flag dark-mode and image-off breakage.
say_en.note: Returns client-render matrix and defect list.

say_en.text: This renders broken in Outlook — fix the layout and add image-off fallbacks.
say_en.note: Rebuilds HTML and updates QA report.
